name: creole
description: Training-free context compaction for coding agents: Creole, a compact working language for notes, plans and replies, plus compaction of long sessions into a small session graph of the task, the user's constraints and the current work.

interface.shortDescription: Fewer tokens, same work: a compact working language and compaction that keeps the task
interface.longDescription: A compact working language for notes, plans and replies, plus compaction of long sessions into a small session graph of the task, the user's constraints and the current work, shared with subagents.
